highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback.
highlights_body: The Skia m152 release adds a Silk.NET Vulkan integration and file-backed fonts on Nano Server. It also strengthens native-object lifetimes, reduces copying, and improves native symbol packages.

bullets.detail: Updates the engine to m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, with subsequent servicing corrections including safe cached-data mutex cleanup.

Adds Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, recorders, recordings, texture wrappers, and SKGraphiteImageCache. Graphite uses explicit record/snap/insert/submit operations; Ganesh remains unchanged. Browser WebGPU uses Dawn, and Graphite readback is asynchronous.

SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped results with copy-out helpers. Copy data before the callback returns; use GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion to drain submitted Ganesh work. Failure delivers a null result.
Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with GRSilkNetBackendContext and typed extension initialization, and makes GRVkExtensions() public. Existing SharpVk integration remains available.
Region iterators retain their source region, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing collection from leaving dangling native references.

Fixes pixel-buffer cleanup when raster SKImage.Create fails, disposes the previous buffer on SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset, and releases consumed non-memory-backed streams when their HarfBuzz blob is released.

SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets; .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 retain the buffered path. Font.Shape avoids copying caller feature arrays, tag formatting avoids char boxing, and text encoding and wrapper lookup reduce overhead.

bullets.lead: Load fonts explicitly on Nano Server
bullets.detail: The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so fonts loaded with SKTypeface.FromStream/FromData/FromFile can render. Its empty default font manager still supplies no system fonts; normal Windows builds retain DirectWrite.
Produces separate Apple symbol packages with complete dSYMs while keeping customer runtime packages symbol-free. Android libraries retain deterministic build IDs and matching split-debug identities.
Carries upstream Ganesh corrections for readbacks after failed flushes and further font-rendering and GPU stability fixes.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled caller-loaded fonts on Nano Server through the FreeType-backed native build.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Reduced Windows native build overhead by initializing the MSVC environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Silk.NET Vulkan helper. It also added Nano Server font loading and fixed region, pixmap, and raster-image lifetimes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 restored Silk.NET package production, reduced shaping allocations, and fixed uniform-buffer and stream cleanup. It also added Apple symbol packages and deterministic Android debug identities.

harfbuzz_summary: Font.Shape avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids char boxing. Apple symbol packages add complete dSYMs, while Android native libraries carry deterministic build IDs and matching debug identities.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and asynchronous pixel readback.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: Release Candidate 1 improves native debugging symbols, shaping allocations, and resource cleanup.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds a native cached-data lifetime correction to the release candidate.
